turns.content: Prop-1-en-2-ylcyclopentane is treated with HCl. Determine the major chloride, including any ring-expanding carbocation rearrangement.
Treat that chloride with alcoholic KOH. Identify the major beta-elimination alkene and justify the alkene position.
Apply reductive ozonolysis, O3 followed by (CH3)2S, to that alkene and draw or describe the carbonyl product.
Check the carbon skeleton of the ozonolysis product against the original isopropenylcyclopentane so that the rearranged ring atoms are tracked correctly.
Summarize the chloride, alkene, and open-chain dicarbonyl intermediates obtained in the first three stages.
Under aqueous NaOH, identify the enolate and electrophilic carbonyl that give the favored intramolecular aldol closure. Compare the feasible ring sizes.
For the favored closure, state which carbonyl remains in the product and which becomes the alcohol, and verify the new C-C bond.
Use that connectivity to determine the major beta-hydroxy carbonyl product by name.
State the mechanistic selectivity conclusion with appropriate caution about unspecified reaction conditions and competing closures.
Give the final product and summarize the HCl addition, elimination, ozonolysis, and intramolecular aldol sequence.
